review 9: a Font Awesome size class (fa-2x) is not the name; the icon class is
a fixed-width class (fa-fw) is not the name; the icon class is
a toggle is named from the icon it shows, not the hidden one for its other state
a stacked icon whose icons disagree is not named from a class (the AI is asked)
a flip modifier is not the name; the icon class is
an icon class is read whole (bi-info-circle is Info circle, not Circle)
a control's own class beside an svg (has-icon) is not its icon's name (the AI is asked)
review 9: a role=img icon is named from its icon class, without AI
a small role=img with nothing to name it from is not sent to the AI and is left as it was
an informative role=img is described by vision, once, and only it
review 9: a label another field points to by aria-labelledby does not name the field beside it
a hint another field points to by aria-describedby does not name the field beside it
Bootstrap's label badge (class label) is not a field label
a checkbox's label (after it) does not name the next checkbox
a label right before a field, for nothing else, still names it
a framework's field key (ctl00$MainContent$txtEmail) is not a name
